deleteProviderDescription: Are you sure you want to delete "{name}"? Users will no longer be able to sign in with this provider.
name: Name
scopesHint: Space-separated list of OAuth scopes to request.
autoCreateUsersHint: Automatically create user accounts on first login.
mapGroupsToGroups: Map OIDC groups to local groups
mapGroupsToGroupsOidcHint: Reflect values from the OIDC groups claim into Artifact Keeper group memberships on login. Matching groups are auto-created for this provider; operator-managed groups are left unchanged. Off keeps the legacy role-mapping behavior.
allowLegacyRsaKeysHint: Accept ID tokens signed with RSA keys shorter than 2048 bits via a restricted RS256/384/512 PKCS#1 v1.5 fallback. Only enable for legacy IdPs such as Lark AnyCross.
adminGroupHint: Users in this group will be granted admin privileges.
userFilterHint: Use {"{0}"} as a placeholder for the username.
useStarttlsHint: Upgrade the connection to TLS after connecting.
priorityHint: Lower values are tried first when multiple LDAP servers are configured.
keepExistingCertificatePlaceholder: Leave blank to keep existing certificate
signRequestsHint: Sign authentication requests sent to the IdP.
requireSignedAssertionsHint: Require the IdP to sign SAML assertions.
useAbsoluteAcsUrlHint: Send an absolute AssertionConsumerServiceURL in the AuthnRequest instead of the historical relative path. Enable for stricter SAML 2.0 IdPs that reject relative AssertionConsumerServiceURLs (e.g. Lark AnyCross). Off keeps the pre-existing wire format.
mapGroupsToGroupsSaml: Map IdP groups to Artifact Keeper groups
mapGroupsToGroupsSamlHint: Reflect the values of the assertion's groups attribute into Artifact Keeper group memberships on login. Groups are matched by name and auto-created for this provider; the attribute read is the one configured under Groups Attribute below (attribute_mapping.groups). A group this provider did not create, including any operator-managed group of the same name, is never reused: that membership is refused instead. Membership is reconciled on every login, so removing a group at the IdP removes the membership here; only groups this provider created are touched. Off keeps the legacy role-mapping behavior.
